scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @tradewise/shared && concurrently -k -n API,WEB,FEED "npm run dev --workspace @tradewise/server" "npm run dev --workspace @tradewise/client" "npm run dev:feed --workspace @tradewise/server"
scripts.seed: npm run migrate && npm run seed --workspace @tradewise/server
scripts.migrate:up: npm run build --workspace @tradewise/shared && npm run migrate:up --workspace @tradewise/server
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @tradewise/shared && npm run dev --workspace @tradewise/server
scripts.dev:feed: npm run build --workspace @tradewise/shared && npm run dev:feed --workspace @tradewise/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build --workspace @tradewise/shared && npm run dev --workspace @tradewise/client
scripts.migrate: npm run build --workspace @tradewise/shared && npm run migrate --workspace @tradewise/server
